newsitem.title: USA: Martin Color-Fi agrees to settle lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Martin Color-Fi agrees to settle lawsuit.

text.p: Martin Color-Fi Inc said Friday it has agreed to settle a lawsuit by a shareholder alleging violations of federal securities laws and related state laws.
"The parties have agreed in principle to enter into a settlement agreement to end the litigation," the company said in a statement.
Final settlement of the matter is contingent upon execution of a definitive settlement agreement and court approval of the agreement, it said. The lawsuit has been pending since March 16, 1995.
Results for the fourth quarter of 1995 were reduced by an after-tax charge of $777,000, or $0.12 per share, to reflect the estimated costs associated with settlement, it said.
Martin Color-Fi, Inc. produces polyester fibers from recycled plastics such as soft drink bottles and film waste.
